//: Deploy settings. scripts/build_site.py reads this to stamp absolute URLs into the pages and to generate robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
//site_url: No trailing slash. Change this one value when the custom domain goes live and re-run build_site.py; canonical, og:url, og:image and the sitemap all follow it.
//cf_beacon_token: Cloudflare Web Analytics site token. NOT a secret — it is a public identifier that ships in the page by design. Get it at Cloudflare dashboard > Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics > add a site > copy the token from the snippet. Leave empty and no analytics script is injected at all.
//indexable: true writes a robots.txt that allows crawling and a sitemap. false switches to Disallow plus a noindex tag.
